summary: The customer called angrily complaining that their order was delayed by two weeks despite paying for express shipping. The agent checked the system, blamed the main warehouse and courier service, and eventually escalated the order with a promise that it would arrive tomorrow afternoon. The customer agreed to wait until then.

evidence.text: أبشر، راح أعملها escalate لأعلى مستوى وأطلب express delivery خاصة لك، وبتكون عندك بكرة العصر أكيد.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Escalate the order and request special express delivery to arrive by tomorrow afternoon.

evidence.text: بحمد الله مش إحنا السبب الوحيد، بس الـ courier service عندهم pressure عالي هي الفترة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent blamed the courier service and warehouse instead of taking full ownership of the customer's issue.

evidence.text: يا سيدي أهلاً وسهلاً، ولا يهمك، هات رقم الـ order لو سمحت عشان أشيكلك عليه.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained composure and used polite greetings, though slightly too casual at times.

evidence.text: أنا فاهم غضبك تماماً، والله حاسس فيك، وبدي أعمل الـ possible كله عشان أسرع الموضوع.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's anger and expressed understanding, though initially defensive.

evidence.text: أبشر، راح أعملها escalate لأعلى مستوى وأطلب express delivery خاصة لك، وبتكون عندك بكرة العصر أكيد.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided a concrete escalation and a specific delivery timeframe to resolve the issue.

evidence.text: ثواني خليني أبّعت الشاشة وأشوف الـ system... أه، الأنباء مش واضحة تماماً، apparently فيه delay بالمخزن الرئيسي.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained the delay, but the explanation was somewhat disjointed and mixed Arabic and English.

evidence.text: يسلم فمك يا أستاذ، ويعطيك العافية وشكراً لصبرك معنا، تامرني بشي تاني؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent checked if the customer needed anything else and thanked them for their patience, though the customer abruptly hung up.

evidence.text: أه، الأنباء مش واضحة تماماً، apparently فيه delay بالمخزن الرئيسي.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent struggled initially to find clear information in the system regarding the shipment delay.

evidence.text: بحمد الله مش إحنا السبب الوحيد، بس الـ courier service عندهم pressure عالي هي الفترة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent violated standard procedures by deflecting blame onto the courier service instead of taking responsibility.

quote.speaker: Customer

quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: شو يعني delay بالمخزن؟ Don't tell me delayed! أنا بدي الأغراض اليوم ضروري جداً!

quote.text: I don't care about their pressure! أنا زبون ولازم طلبيتي توصل بموعدها! If it doesn't arrive tomorrow morning, I will cancel the whole order!

quote.text: تمام، I will wait until tomorrow afternoon, بس لو ما وصلت، راح أقدم شكبة رسمية عليكُم!
